# Prissy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** sixteen  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Prissy Andrews has a beautiful complexion, a smooth white throat, and curly brown hair styled elegantly. She wears a new pink-silk waist, real carnations in her hair, and a string of pearls around her neck.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)_

## History

Prissy Andrews was known to sit up half the night cramming during her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination week. She attended school alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), where they all sat in the same classroom under Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). Prissy later took her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examinations in town at the same time as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phillips--prissy-andrews.md)

Prissy Andrews is romantically involved with Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md). He showed his affection toward her by gifting her Mayflowers accompanied by the phrase 'sweets to the sweet.'

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XX. A Good Imagination Gone Wrong P1](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0001)_
